Passively grants +30 Airborne Effectiveness to <title Weapons of Sorrow [WoS] />.

Melee Hits apply Poison. 
Poison deals up to <pve [?] /> <pvp [30] /> damage over its duration.
Bosses take an additional 80% damage from Poison.

Each successive Poison tick deals 9% more damage. Lasts 19 ticks.

Poisoned enemies spread poison on death in a 3 metres radius. 
This applies even if the source of the poison wasn't a melee attack.

title WoS (

Kills with the following also spread poison:
   • Thorn's Bullets <breakSpaces/>

   • Touch of Malice's Blight's Poison Effect <breakSpaces/>

Passively grants 30 Airborne Effectiveness to Weapons of Sorrow: Thorn, Osteo Striga, Touch of Malice, and Necrochasm.

Melee Hits apply Necrotic Poison ('Poison' for short). Poisoned enemies spread Poison on death in a 5 meter radius.

Poison ticks every <pve 0.52 /> <pvp [0.7] /> seconds for a total of <pve 19 /> <pvp [?] /> ticks over <pve 10 /> <pvp [?] /> seconds. Deals a total of <pve 1361 /> <pvp [?] /> damage over the entire duration.

Poison's first tick deals <pve 32.35 /> <pvp [5?] /> damage.

In PvE, the damage of Poison ramps up every tick with the damage increases compounding together:
• 2nd-14th ticks each deal 3.5585 more damage compared to the one before
• 15th tick deals 9.705 more damage than the 14th
• 16th-19th ticks each deal 14.234 more damage

Kills with the following also spread Necrotic Poison:
• Thorn's Bullets
• Osteo Striga's Poison Effect
• Touch of Malice's Blight's Poison Effect
• Necrochasm's (???)

Passively grants 30 Airborne Effectiveness to Weapons of Sorrow: <yellow Thorn, Osteo Striga, Touch of Malice, Cull's Shadow, and Necrochasm. />

Melee Hits apply Potent Corruption. Corruption deals Kinetic damage. Defeated enemies spread Potent Corruption on death in a 5 meter radius.

Kills with the following also spread the Potent Corruption:
• Thorn's Bullets
• Osteo Striga's Corruption Effect
• Touch of Malice's Blight's Corruption Effect
• Necrochasm's Corruption and Cursed Thrall Explosions
• Cull's Shadow Corruption Effect

Potent Corruption ticks every <pve 0.52 /> <pvp [0.7] /> seconds for a total of <pve 19 /> <pvp [?] /> ticks over <pve 10 /> <pvp [?] /> seconds. Deals a total of <pve 1366 /> <pvp [?] /> damage over the entire duration.

Corruption's first tick deals <pve 32.35 /> <pvp [5?] /> damage.

Exclusive to 'Potent Corruption': DoT ramps up every tick, with the damage increases compounding together. For the first 14 ticks, each tick deals 11% more damage than the last. For the last 5 ticks, the damage increases by an average of 41% per tick.
